faqs.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to know about our courses and programs

items.question: What courses does Aptech Learning Whitefield offer?
items.answer: We offer a comprehensive range of IT courses specialized in AI & Machine Learning, Data Science, Generative AI, Data Analytics & Power BI, Python, Cybersecurity, Full Stack Development, Cloud Computing, Microsoft Technologies and Digital Marketing.

items.question: Do you offer both classroom and online learning?
items.answer: Yes! We offer flexible learning modes — classroom training at our Whitefield centre and live online classes. You can choose the mode that best fits your schedule and learning preference.

items.question: What is the duration of the courses?
items.answer: Course durations vary by program and are offered in hours, from short 24-hour programs to comprehensive 384-hour programs.

items.question: Do you provide placement assistance?
items.answer:
Absolutely! We have a dedicated placement cell that provides resume building, LinkedIn optimization, mock interviews, soft skills training and direct referrals to our 50+ hiring partner companies. We maintain a 95% placement rate.
Placement assistance is applicable for long term courses called Smart Professional Programs

items.question: What certifications will I receive after completing a course?
items.answer:
Upon successful completion, you receive globally recognized Aptech certifications. These are industry-valued credentials that enhance your resume and are recognized by employers across India and internationally.

Exclusively in our Center, we offer Free vouchers to get certify on Microsoft, Google Certifications on selected long term programs.

items.question: Who can enroll in your courses?
items.answer: Our courses are open to students (10+2 and above), fresh graduates, working professionals looking to upskill, career changers and job seekers. We have programs suitable for all experience levels from beginner to advanced.

items.question: Do you offer corporate training programs?
items.answer: Yes, we offer customized corporate training programs for companies looking to upskill their teams. We deliver instructor-led training in AI, Data Science, Microsoft Technologies, Power BI and more — tailored to your specific business needs.

items.question: How can I book a free career counselling session?
items.answer: You can book a free career counselling session by clicking the 'Book Free Career Counselling' button on our website, calling us at +91 74113 33500, or WhatsApp-ing us. Our counsellors will help you choose the right course for your career goals.
